definitions.gloss: youngest child; baby of the family
definitions.explanation: The youngest child in a family. Often associated with being spoiled or doted on by parents and older siblings. Composed of 末 (end, last) + っ子 (child — suffix).

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末|すえ}っ{子|こ}だ。
examples.english: I am the youngest of three siblings.

examples.japanese: {末|すえ}っ{子|こ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{甘|あま}やかされ→甘やかす：06625_amayakasu⟧がちだ。
examples.english: The youngest child tends to always be spoiled.

examples.japanese: {末|すえ}っ{子|こ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦ほっとした→ほっとする：07652_hottosuru⟧。
examples.english: As a parent, I felt relieved when my youngest child graduated from university.

notes:
USAGE:
{末|すえ}っ{子|こ} is a warm, familiar word used in everyday conversation about families. The stereotype of the {末|すえ}っ{子|こ} in Japanese culture is similar to the Western "baby of the family" — often seen as spoiled, charming, and free-spirited.
